generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: stem usually subterranean, in shallow soils an aerial stem 1 to 2 m tall, 30 to 60 cm across; 50 to 100 leaves, 0.7 to 2 m long, the petiole 12 to 40 cm; leaflets in 70 to 130 pairs, 16 to 35 cm by 4 to 12 mm. Drawn as a trunk 0.2 m in radius, rising 0.01 m a year; fronds 1.35 m long, the petiole 0.19 of them, 100 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.19 of the frond; 25 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 10 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Female cones one to six on peduncles 8 to 30 cm, male cones one to ten on peduncles 10 to 15 cm.

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: stem usually subterranean, in shallow soils an aerial stem 1 to 2 m tall, 30 to 60 cm across; 50 to 100 leaves, 0.7 to 2 m long, the petiole 12 to 40 cm; leaflets in 70 to 130 pairs, 16 to 35 cm by 4 to 12 mm. The whole plant's height at 60 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 2.5 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

traits.cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: female cones cylindrical, 20 to 45 cm long, erect, drooping when mature.

traits.cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: female cone 10 to 20 cm across.

traits.cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: the megasporophyll's face 1.5 to 4.3 by 3 to 8.5 cm, glaucous, with one flat erect spine.

traits.cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: female cones cylindrical.

traits.cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: female cone glaucous green; the colour by eye.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: male cones cylindrical, 20 to 45 cm long, erect, drooping after the pollen is shed.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: male cone 8 to 12 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: the microsporophyll's face 1.5 to 2.5 by 2 to 4 cm, with one upturned flat spine.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: male cones cylindrical.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: male cone glaucous green; the colour by eye.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: sclerotesta ovoid to globular, 3 to 3.5 cm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: sclerotesta 2.2 to 2.5 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: sarcotesta vermilion red when ripe, rarely yellow; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 250), Macrozamia communis: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
